_comment: Opt-in flex variant of phase1_default: FD two-way flex-wing coupling (coupled_sim, ~5x slower per scenario). Structure block = FD's final Phase-1 4 genes: stiffness_scale (0.6-2.0 log), torsion_bend_ratio (0.8-1.15 linear; GJ x = s*r), struct_damping_ratio (0.005-0.05 log), nonstructural_mass_scale (0.8-1.25 log). Elastic axis / section CG (CG aft of EA) and tip mass (0) are fixed per aircraft by FD and cannot be overridden. Flutter/divergence margins (finite, capped at 3.0) are constraints: <1.0 fail, <1.2 penalised. Structural objective = FD response terms + wing-mass term (weight 1.0).
name: phase1_flex
